name: text-swap
title: Text Swap
description: Replaces one line of text with another using exit-then-enter scheduling, with five transition presets: fade-through, crossfade, shared-axis-y, shared-axis-z, and cut.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/text-swap?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
